design: 3 (task: OJ, ROJ, NJ; within) x 4 (group; between) mixed design
observation_unit: participant by item by task (32 items per task)
scripted_roles_note: The paper describes no confederates, experimenters or pre-recorded responses.
order: phase 2 information (by group; control filler text)

visibility.info: values (or filler text) of the participant's group
visibility.roj: own transcript incl. OJ answers, information phase, ROJ questions

counterbalancing: Rotation over the six assignments of item sets A, B, C to OJ-set, domain-set and NJ-set (implementation; issue iss_counter).
replay_adaptations: Text only: food images and display are not shown (iss_images).
8-second and 256-second timings are stated in the prompt but cannot be enforced.
Each phase is delivered as one numbered list in the participant's randomized order instead of one screen per item.
The transcript keeps the participant's own OJ answers, so ROJ can reproduce them exactly; people recall imperfectly.
Consent, device checks, response times, compliance questions and the engagement question are not replayed; outlier and item-weight exclusions are applied in evaluation.
Minimal response-format frame added by the adapter (implementation); instruction texts are missing (iss_instructions).
Cities in the irrelevant arm are paired with values by rank, countries/flags omitted except Basel (iss_city).
